findings.evidence: A launcher presence command already buffered in presence_rx is not generation-fenced when a same-socket RomReady reboot is handled. SESSION_READY and RomPresenceReset can therefore be followed by an old lifecycle command with a newly allocated outer sequence.
findings.required_fix: Atomically invalidate buffered and in-flight pre-reset presence, with a deterministic preloaded presence-plus-RomReady regression.

findings.evidence: The capacity-one lane silently drops spawn, update, and despawn alike on TrySendError::Full. Losing spawn makes later updates unusable; losing despawn leaves stale remote state.
findings.required_fix: Use a bounded lifecycle-aware mailbox or fail closed; prove full-lane spawn/despawn behavior and shutdown priority.

findings.evidence: Fieldless RomPresenceReset can be resent after an ambiguous write, so a delayed duplicate cannot be distinguished from a later reboot.
findings.required_fix: Make reset delivery idempotent/correlatable, or enforce and test a lifecycle in which no new realtime core can start until the ambiguous handoff is conclusively terminated.
